To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

Any and all records pertaining to Henry Varnum Poor (b. 1914, d. 1972) of North Branford, Connecticut, including but not limited to those pertaining to the American Committee for the Liberation of the Peoples of Russia and Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty.

The Federal Bureau of Investigation has provided file number 100-HQ-7061 for reference.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 20 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Cory Myers

To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Mississippi Public Records Act, I hereby request the following records:

Pursuant to the Mississippi Public Records Act, I am requesting records identifying individuals convicted under Mississippi Code §97-29-63 (video voyeurism) as well as 97-29-61 who were released from MDOC custody from January 1, 2010, through October 18, 2026.

Please provide, to the extent publicly available:

1. Offender name and MDOC identification number.
2. County and date of conviction.
3. Number of counts and sentence imposed.
4. Date of release.
5. Type of release, including parole, earned-release supervision, conditional release, or sentence completion.
6. Parole Board decision date, if applicable.
7. Time actually served before release.

Please distinguish actual Parole Board grants from other forms of release.

I would prefer the records electronically, ideally in Excel or CSV format. If any portion is exempt from disclosure, please provide the nonexempt information and identify the applicable exemption.

Please advise of any anticipated fees before processing.

Thank you.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 7 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Matilda Jane
